name: io.github.cyanheads/bluesky-mcp-server
description: Search posts, profiles, feeds, threads, and trending topics on Bluesky.

environmentVariables.name: BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER
environmentVariables.description: Handle, DID, or email of the Bluesky account post search runs as. Optional: without it and BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD, bsky_search_posts is not offered, since Bluesky refuses search without a signed-in account. Use a dedicated account — search leaves out posts from accounts in a block relationship with it.

environmentVariables.name: BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: App password for BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER (a standard, non-privileged one — Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords). Optional; required together with BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER to enable bsky_search_posts.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
